kpis_story.description_en: May 2023 TD Bank acquisition ($13.4Bn, $25/sh) failure due to regulatory delay. FHN gets $200M break fee + $25M reimbursement. Standalone strategy since: Southeast focus, balance sheet strengthened, buybacks. Stock recovers pre-deal level.

_notes: Southeast US regional bank. Source: 10-K FY24 filed Feb 2025.
